text: This paper studies solvent screening for MOF catalysis in a small batch reactor.
The method combines in situ infrared tracking with temperature comparison under controlled gas flow.
The best condition reports 82% conversion under mild conditions and improves selectivity.
The dataset contains 500 adsorption isotherms curated from porous materials.
Figure 2: conversion trend under different solvent conditions.
